entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't work. The heart rate is all over the place. It's garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the accuracy. I can definitely help with that. Sometimes a quick reset or a software update can resolve that right away. Do you have the band nearby?
Look, I don't have time for a science project. I don't want to fix it. I just want my money back. I want a refund.

I understand completely. You just want this resolved. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you, Sam. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 24 days ago.
And according to our policy information here, items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you are well within the window.
Fine. So send me the label.

Absolutely. I am processing the return for you now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to sam.jones@email.com. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Great. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
